R2Droid can open a temporary read-only copy of radare2\'s own r2 binary and guide you through overview, filtering, jumping, Hex, decompiler, disassembly, and the swipe-up command panel. You can skip at any time.

This tutorial analyzes a temporary copy of the installed r2 binary. It is opened without -w, with cached writes enabled, so you can explore safely while learning the main workflow.

Use the bottom bar (or the left rail on large screens) to switch between List, Detail, Project, and AI if enabled. The secondary tab row switches sub-pages such as Overview, Functions, Hex, Disassembly, and Command.
The Overview tab summarizes architecture, bits, file type, hashes, entry points, sections, and headers. Address-like items can be copied or opened in Hex/Disassembly from their context actions.
Lists such as Functions, Strings, Sections, Symbols, Imports, and Relocations include a search box at the top. Type part of a name or address to filter; tap an item to jump or open more actions.
In Detail pages, use the top-right Jump button to enter an address, symbol, or r2 expression. The locate button recenters the current cursor, and the back button returns through your address history.
The Hex tab streams bytes for large files. Tap a byte to move the cursor; tap again or long-press for copy, xrefs, custom command, or modify actions. Real patching requires reopening in write mode.

The Decompile tab loads pseudo-code for the current function. Use the build/settings icon to switch r2ghidra, r2dec, native, or AIBeautify and to toggle line numbers, word wrap, zoom reset, or export.
The Disassembly tab supports fast scrolling, tapping instructions, context menus, xrefs, function info, variables, renaming, patch helpers, multi-select, and optional debugger controls.
On phones, swipe up from the bottom navigation bar to open this quick r2 command panel. Try commands like iI, afl, or pd 10. The Project → Command tab offers a full command history view.
Project pages contain session settings, command history, logs, reconnect/save actions, and plugin tools. The top-left menu opens the session drawer and utility calculators.
The basics are covered. Continue practicing in this temporary demo session, or return home and open your own binary when you are ready.
